Who I Am

About Me

I am a results-driven professional with a track record of delivering measurable impact across remote, hybrid, and in-person environments. With a BSc in Healthcare Management and hands-on experience spanning logistics, healthcare, fertility services, digital marketing, and education, I bring a uniquely versatile perspective to every role.

I specialise in executive inbox and calendar management, SLA drafting, client communication, data entry, social media strategy, graphic design, and content creation — ensuring no detail is missed and no opportunity is lost.

From coordinating cross-border logistics between the UK and Nigeria, to creating educational health content for a fertility clinic, to running full digital marketing campaigns — I bring discipline, empathy, and initiative to everything I do.
